goals.statement: Every dollar in and out on record
goals.why_it_matters: The studio spends money while you are not watching — the model budget is by a wide margin the largest ongoing cost — and it will start taking money in the moment a release is something people can pay for. If you cannot say what came in and what went out, you cannot say whether this is worth running.
